-- /home/altjoe/.config/nvim/lua/opencode-manage/foldersview.lua FINAL
-- opencode-manage.foldersview — the permissions viewer (doc 23, PM1).
-- Persistent two-pane viewer over folder memory + captured candidates:
--   j/k move · a approve · x avoid · d remove · o open · s sync ·
--   v verify · r refresh · Q kill
-- Approve writes state.db memory; `s` merges approved rows into
-- opencode.json external_directory (journaled, additive-only); `v` reports
-- drift both ways. Candidates come from O1 dir tags (top 100), filtered by
-- hidden trees and decided ancestors.

local folders = require("opencode-manage.folders")

local M = {}

local state = {
	items = {},
	idx = 1,
	list_buf = nil,
	detail_buf = nil,
	list_win = nil,
	detail_win = nil,
	outer_win = nil,
	origin_win = nil,
	origin_buf = nil,
	autocmd = nil,
	report = nil, -- last verify report
}

local function define_hls()
	local hl = vim.api.nvim_set_hl
	hl(0, "ManageFolderOk", { fg = "#4ec9b0" }) -- approved
	hl(0, "ManageFolderAvoid", { fg = "#f44747" }) -- avoid
	hl(0, "ManageFolderCand", { fg = "#569cd6" }) -- candidate
	hl(0, "ManageFolderDrift", { fg = "#e5c07b" }) -- approved but not in config
end

local function short(path)
	return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":~")
end

local function secs(v)
	local n = tonumber(v) or 0
	if n > 100000000000 then
		return n / 1000
	end
	return n
end

local function fmt_when(ts)
	local n = tonumber(ts)
	if not n or n == 0 then
		return "?"
	end
	return os.date("%m-%d %H:%M", math.floor(secs(n)))
end

local function load_items()
	local rows = folders.list()
	local cfg = folders.config_entries()
	local out = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
		out[#out + 1] = {
			kind = r.status == "avoid" and "avoid" or "approved",
			id = r.id,
			path = r.path,
			scope = r.scope,
			source = r.source,
			uses = r.uses or 0,
			last = r.last_seen,
			note = r.note,
			in_config = cfg[folders.entry_for(r.path)] ~= nil,
		}
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(folders.candidates()) do
		out[#out + 1] = {
			kind = "candidate",
			path = c.path,
			scope = "—",
			uses = c.n,
			last = c.last,
		}
	end
	state.items = out
	state.idx = math.max(1, math.min(state.idx, #out))
end

local function render_list()
	local lines = { "📁 FOLDERS" }
	local row_hl = {}
	for i, it in ipairs(state.items) do
		local marker = i == state.idx and ">" or " "
		local tag = it.kind == "approved" and "ok " or (it.kind == "avoid" and "x  " or "?  ")
		local drift = (it.kind == "approved" and not it.in_config) and " !" or ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"%s [%s] %-42s %-7s u=%-3s %s%s",
			marker,
			tag,
			short(it.path),
			tostring(it.scope or "—"),
			tostring(it.uses or 0),
			fmt_when(it.last),
			drift
		)
		row_hl[#lines] = (it.kind == "approved" and not it.in_config) and "ManageFolderDrift"
			or (it.kind == "approved" and "ManageFolderOk")
			or (it.kind == "avoid" and "ManageFolderAvoid")
			or "ManageFolderCand"
	end
	if #state.items == 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  — none yet — candidates appear as sessions touch directories, or approve manually —"
	end
	vim.bo[state.list_buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(state.list_buf, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[state.list_buf].modifiable = false
	local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("manage-folders")
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(state.list_buf, ns, 0, -1)
	for ln, hl in pairs(row_hl) do
		vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(state.list_buf, ns, hl, ln - 1, 0, -1)
	end
	local total = vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(state.list_buf)
	local target = math.min(state.idx + 1, total)
	pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor, state.list_win, { target, 0 })
end

local function render_detail()
	local it = state.items[state.idx]
	local lines = {}
	if not it then
		lines = { "— nothing selected —" }
	else
		lines[#lines + 1] = "path:      " .. short(it.path)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "status:    " .. it.kind .. (it.id and ("  (id " .. tostring(it.id) .. ")") or "")
		lines[#lines + 1] = "scope:     " .. tostring(it.scope or "—")
		if it.kind ~= "candidate" then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "source:    " .. tostring(it.source or "manual")
			lines[#lines + 1] = "in config: " .. (it.in_config and "yes" or "NO — press s to sync")
		end
		lines[#lines + 1] = "uses:      " .. tostring(it.uses or 0) .. "  ·  last: " .. fmt_when(it.last)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "note:      " .. tostring(it.note or "—")
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.rep("─", 44)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "a approve · x avoid · d remove · o open · s sync · v verify"
		if state.report then
			lines[#lines + 1] = string.rep("─", 44)
			lines[#lines + 1] = "verify:"
			if #state.report.missing == 0 and #state.report.extra == 0 then
				lines[#lines + 1] = "  in sync"
			else
				for _, m in ipairs(state.report.missing) do
					lines[#lines + 1] = "  missing from config: " .. m
				end
				for _, e in ipairs(state.report.extra) do
					lines[#lines + 1] = "  in config, not in memory: " .. e
				end
			end
		end
	end
	vim.bo[state.detail_buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(state.detail_buf, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[state.detail_buf].modifiable = false
end

local function set_legend()
	local parts = { "FOLDERS · %d · ", "%#ManageFolderOk#[ok]%* approved  ", "%#ManageFolderCand#[?]%* candidate  " }
	if state.list_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.list_win) then
		vim.wo[state.list_win].winbar = string.format(
			"FOLDERS · %d · %%=%#ManageFolderOk#[ok]%* approved  %#ManageFolderCand#[?]%* candidate  %#ManageFolderAvoid#[x]%* avoid  %#ManageFolderDrift#!%* drift · a x d o s v r Q ",
			#state.items
		)
	end
end

local function refresh()
	load_items()
	render_list()
	render_detail()
	set_legend()
end

local function current()
	return state.items[state.idx]
end

local function do_approve()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if it.kind == "approved" then
		vim.notify("folders: already approved", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return
	end
	vim.ui.select({ "common", "project" }, { prompt = "scope for " .. short(it.path) }, function(scope)
		if not scope then
			return
		end
		if folders.approve(it.path, scope, nil, it.uses, it.last) then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
end

local function do_avoid()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if folders.avoid(it.path) then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function do_remove()
	local it = current()
	if not it or not it.id then
		vim.notify("folders: no row to remove (candidate — x to avoid, a to approve)", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return
	end
	local choice = vim.fn.confirm("Remove the memory row for " .. short(it.path) .. "?\n(config entries stay; sync never deletes)", "&Remove\n&Cancel", 2)
	if choice ~= 1 then
		return
	end
	if folders.remove(it.id) then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function do_open()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(it.path) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("folders: not a directory: " .. it.path, vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf, state.origin_win, state.origin_buf)
	pcall(vim.cmd, "edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(it.path))
end

local function do_sync()
	folders.sync()
	refresh()
end

local function do_verify()
	state.report = folders.verify()
	render_detail()
end

local function kill()
	if state.autocmd then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_autocmd, state.autocmd)
		state.autocmd = nil
	end
	for _, w in ipairs({ state.list_win, state.detail_win, state.outer_win }) do
		if w and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(w) then
			pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_close, w, true)
		end
	end
	if state.origin_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.origin_win) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_set_current_win, state.origin_win)
	end
end

local function make_window(buf, name, height)
	local win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(buf, false, {
		relative = "win",
		win = state.outer_win,
		row = 0,
		col = 0,
		width = 1,
		height = math.max(1, height),
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	vim.wo[win].winbar = name
	return win
end

local function map_keys()
	local function nmap(lhs, fn, desc)
		vim.keymap.set("n", lhs, fn, { buffer = state.list_buf, nowait = true, desc = desc })
	end
	nmap("j", function()
		state.idx = math.min(state.idx + 1, #state.items)
		refresh()
	end, "folders: next")
	nmap("k", function()
		state.idx = math.max(state.idx - 1, 1)
		refresh()
	end, "folders: prev")
	nmap("a", do_approve, "folders: approve")
	nmap("x", do_avoid, "folders: avoid")
	nmap("d", do_remove, "folders: remove row")
	nmap("o", do_open, "folders: open")
	nmap("s", do_sync, "folders: sync config")
	nmap("v", do_verify, "folders: verify drift")
	nmap("r", refresh, "folders: refresh")
	nmap("Q", kill, "folders: close")
	nmap("<CR>", do_open, "folders: open")
end

function M.open()
	define_hls()
	state.origin_win = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
	state.origin_buf = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
	state.list_buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	state.detail_buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	for _, b in ipairs({ state.list_buf, state.detail_buf }) do
		vim.bo[b].buftype = "nofile"
		vim.bo[b].bufhidden = "wipe"
		vim.bo[b].swapfile = false
	end
	local total_w = vim.o.columns
	local total_h = vim.o.lines - vim.o.cmdheight - 1
	local list_w = math.max(30, math.floor(total_w * 0.45))
	local detail_w = total_w - list_w - 1
	state.outer_win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.list_buf, true, {
		relative = "editor",
		row = 0,
		col = 0,
		width = total_w,
		height = total_h,
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	vim.wo[state.outer_win].winbar = "FOLDERS"
	state.list_win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.list_buf, true, {
		relative = "win",
		win = state.outer_win,
		row = 0,
		col = 0,
		width = list_w,
		height = total_h,
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	state.detail_win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.detail_buf, false, {
		relative = "win",
		win = state.outer_win,
		row = 0,
		col = list_w + 1,
		width = detail_w,
		height = total_h,
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	vim.wo[state.detail_win].winbar = "DETAIL"
	state.autocmd = vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("WinEnter", {
		callback = function()
			if vim.api.nvim_get_current_win() ~= state.list_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.list_win) then
				vim.schedule(function()
					if vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.list_win) then
						pcall(vim.api.nvim_set_current_win, state.list_win)
					end
				end)
			end
		end,
	})
	map_keys()
	refresh()
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(state.list_win)
end

return M

-- /home/altjoe/.config/nvim/lua/opencode-manage/folders.lua FINAL
-- opencode-manage.folders — folder permission memory + sync (doc 23, PM1).
-- MEMORY: state.db `folders` rows (this module). ENFORCEMENT:
-- ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json `permission.external_directory`.
-- The console owns both: approving writes memory; sync merges approved rows
-- into the config (journaled, ADDITIVE-ONLY — manual config entries are
-- never removed); verify reports drift in both directions. The plugin reads
-- both but writes neither (the airlock holds).
-- Candidates come free from O1: `dir` tags the plugin already captures.
-- Store helpers copied from refs.lua (store consolidation is the registry's
-- business, not this slice's).

local journal = require("opencode-manage.journal")
local json = require("opencode-manage.json")

local M = {}

local sqlite = nil

local FOLDERS_SCHEMA = [[
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS folders (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'project',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved',
  source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  uses INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_seen INTEGER,
  note TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_folders_path ON folders(path);
]]

--- Nearest state.db: walk up from cwd looking for .opencode; stop at the
--- project root (first dir with .git). Never creates directories.
--- @return string
local function store_path()
	local dir = vim.fn.getcwd()
	for _ = 1, 12 do
		local candidate = dir .. "/.opencode"
		if vim.fn.isdirectory(candidate) == 1 then
			return candidate .. "/state.db"
		end
		if vim.fn.isdirectory(dir .. "/.git") == 1 then
			break
		end
		local parent = vim.fn.fnamemodify(dir, ":h")
		if parent == dir then
			break
		end
		dir = parent
	end
	return vim.fn.getcwd() .. "/.opencode/state.db"
end

--- Read-only open: existing store or nil.
--- @return table|nil
local function open()
	local path = store_path()
	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) ~= 1 then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, db = pcall(function()
		if not sqlite then
			sqlite = require("sqlite")
		end
		return sqlite:open(path)
	end)
	if not ok or type(db) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	pcall(function()
		db:execute(FOLDERS_SCHEMA)
	end)
	return db
end

--- Writer open: creates the .opencode dir, the DB file, and the schema.
--- @return table|nil
local function open_writable()
	local path = store_path()
	vim.fn.mkdir(vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h"), "p")
	local ok, db = pcall(function()
		if not sqlite then
			sqlite = require("sqlite")
		end
		return sqlite:open(path)
	end)
	if not ok or type(db) ~= "table" then
		vim.notify("❌ folders: could not open/create store at " .. path, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return nil
	end
	pcall(function()
		db:execute(FOLDERS_SCHEMA)
	end)
	return db
end

local function home()
	return vim.env.HOME or ""
end

--- Expand a leading ~/ to HOME.
--- @param path string
--- @return string
local function expand(path)
	if type(path) == "string" and path:sub(1, 2) == "~/" then
		return home() .. path:sub(2)
	end
	return path or ""
end

--- The opencode config (the enforcement surface).
--- @return string
local function config_path()
	return home() .. "/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
end

--- Normalized absolute path: expanded, no trailing slash.
--- @param path string
--- @return string
local function norm(path)
	return (expand(path):gsub("/+$", ""))
end

--- Config-entry form of a folder: "~/x/**" (home shortened).
--- @param path string
--- @return string
function M.entry_for(path)
	local p = norm(path)
	local h = home()
	if h ~= "" and p:sub(1, #h) == h then
		p = "~" .. p:sub(#h + 1)
	end
	return p .. "/**"
end

--- Folder rows: approved first, then avoid, by path.
--- @return table[]
function M.list()
	local db = open()
	if not db then
		return {}
	end
	local rows = {}
	pcall(function()
		local res = db:eval(
			"SELECT id, ts, path, scope, status, source, uses, last_seen, note FROM folders "
				.. "ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'approved' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, path ASC"
		)
		if type(res) == "table" then
			rows = res
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	return rows
end

--- True when path is the row's path or under it.
--- @param path string
--- @param row_path string
--- @return boolean
local function covered_by(path, row_path)
	local p, d = norm(path), norm(row_path)
	return p == d or p:sub(1, #d + 1) == d .. "/"
end

--- Candidate dirs the plugin already captured (O1 event_tags, kind=dir):
--- under $HOME, not hidden trees, not covered by a decided row. Top 100.
--- @return table[]
function M.candidates()
	local db = open()
	if not db then
		return {}
	end
	local raw = {}
	pcall(function()
		local res = db:eval(
			"SELECT tag AS path, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(event_ts) AS last FROM event_tags "
				.. "WHERE kind = 'dir' GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC, tag ASC LIMIT 200"
		)
		if type(res) == "table" then
			raw = res
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	local decided = M.list()
	local out = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(raw) do
		local p = norm(c.path)
		local skip = p == ""
		if not skip and home() ~= "" and p:sub(1, #home()) ~= home() then
			skip = true
		end
		if not skip and p:find("/%.", 1) then
			skip = true -- hidden trees (.git, .cache, …)
		end
		if not skip then
			for _, r in ipairs(decided) do
				if covered_by(p, r.path) then
					skip = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if not skip then
			out[#out + 1] = { path = p, n = tonumber(c.n) or 0, last = tonumber(c.last) or 0 }
		end
		if #out >= 100 then
			break
		end
	end
	return out
end

--- Insert or update the row for an exact path.
--- @param path string
--- @param status string  "approved" | "avoid"
--- @param scope string  "project" | "common"
--- @param note string|nil
--- @param uses number|nil
--- @param last_seen number|nil
--- @return boolean
local function upsert(path, status, scope, note, uses, last_seen)
	local db = open_writable()
	if not db then
		return false
	end
	local p = norm(path)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local rows = db:eval("SELECT id FROM folders WHERE path = ? LIMIT 1", { p })
		if type(rows) == "table" and rows[1] then
			db:eval(
				"UPDATE folders SET ts = ?, status = ?, scope = ?, note = COALESCE(?, note), "
					.. "uses = COALESCE(?, uses), last_seen = COALESCE(?, last_seen), "
					.. "source = CASE WHEN ? THEN 'captured' ELSE source END WHERE id = ?",
				{ os.time() * 1000, status, scope, note, uses, last_seen, uses ~= nil, rows[1].id }
			)
		else
			db:eval(
				"INSERT INTO folders (ts, path, scope, status, source, uses, last_seen, note) "
					.. "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
				{
					os.time() * 1000,
					p,
					scope,
					status,
					uses ~= nil and "captured" or "manual",
					uses or 0,
					last_seen,
					note,
				}
			)
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	return ok
end

--- Approve a folder. Refuses when a decided ancestor already covers it.
--- @param path string
--- @param scope string|nil  default: project
--- @param note string|nil
--- @param uses number|nil  (captured candidates carry their touch count)
--- @param last_seen number|nil
--- @return boolean
function M.approve(path, scope, note, uses, last_seen)
	local p = norm(path)
	if p == "" then
		return false
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(M.list()) do
		if covered_by(p, r.path) and norm(r.path) ~= p then
			vim.notify(
				string.format("folders: %s is already covered by %s (%s)", p, r.path, r.status),
				vim.log.levels.INFO
			)
			return false
		end
	end
	local ok = upsert(p, "approved", scope or "project", note, uses, last_seen)
	if ok then
		vim.notify(string.format("🔐 approved: %s (%s)", p, scope or "project"), vim.log.levels.INFO)
	end
	return ok
end

--- Mark a folder as avoid (never offered, never indexed).
--- @param path string
--- @param note string|nil
--- @return boolean
function M.avoid(path, note)
	local ok = upsert(norm(path), "avoid", "project", note)
	if ok then
		vim.notify("🚫 avoid: " .. norm(path), vim.log.levels.INFO)
	end
	return ok
end

--- Remove a folder row.
--- @param id number
--- @return boolean
function M.remove(id)
	local db = open_writable()
	if not db then
		return false
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		db:eval("DELETE FROM folders WHERE id = ?", { tonumber(id) })
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	return ok
end

--- The config's external_directory entries (entry -> allow/deny).
--- @return table<string, string>
function M.config_entries()
	local file = config_path()
	local out = {}
	if vim.fn.filereadable(file) ~= 1 then
		return out
	end
	local f = io.open(file, "r")
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	local raw = f:read("*a")
	f:close()
	local ok, data = pcall(vim.json.decode, raw)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		return out
	end
	local perm = data.permission
	if type(perm) == "table" and type(perm.external_directory) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(perm.external_directory) do
			out[k] = tostring(v)
		end
	end
	return out
end

--- Merge approved rows into permission.external_directory (journaled,
--- additive-only: manual config entries are never removed). The config is
--- rewritten pretty (sorted keys) — a one-time normalization.
--- @return table|nil  { added = entry[] } or nil on failure
function M.sync()
	local file = config_path()
	if vim.fn.filereadable(file) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("❌ folders: config not found: " .. file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return nil
	end
	local f = io.open(file, "r")
	if not f then
		vim.notify("❌ folders: cannot open " .. file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return nil
	end
	local raw = f:read("*a")
	f:close()
	local ok, data = pcall(vim.json.decode, raw)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
		vim.notify("❌ folders: config does not parse: " .. file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
		return nil
	end
	local perm = data.permission
	if type(perm) ~= "table" then
		perm = {}
		data.permission = perm
	end
	local ext = perm.external_directory
	if type(ext) ~= "table" then
		ext = {}
		perm.external_directory = ext
	end
	local added = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(M.list()) do
		if r.status == "approved" then
			local key = M.entry_for(r.path)
			if ext[key] == nil then
				ext[key] = "allow"
				added[#added + 1] = key
			end
		end
	end
	if #added == 0 then
		vim.notify("🔐 folders: external_directory already covers every approved folder", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return { added = {} }
	end
	local snap = journal.snapshot(file)
	vim.fn.writefile(vim.split(json.pretty(data), "\n", { plain = true }), file)
	journal.record({
		ts = os.time() * 1000,
		path = file,
		group = "folders",
		op = "folders-sync",
		snapshot = snap,
		existed = snap ~= nil,
		reason = "external_directory += " .. table.concat(added, ", "),
		sessionID = nil,
	})
	vim.notify(
		"🔐 folders: synced " .. #added .. " entr(y/ies) into external_directory",
		vim.log.levels.INFO
	)
	return { added = added }
end

--- Drift report: approved-without-config (missing) and config-without-row
--- (extra — manual entries included, informational).
--- @return table  { missing = string[], extra = string[] }
function M.verify()
	local ext = M.config_entries()
	local approved = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(M.list()) do
		if r.status == "approved" then
			approved[M.entry_for(r.path)] = true
		end
	end
	local missing, extra = {}, {}
	for k in pairs(approved) do
		if ext[k] == nil then
			missing[#missing + 1] = k
		end
	end
	for k in pairs(ext) do
		if not approved[k] then
			extra[#extra + 1] = k
		end
	end
	table.sort(missing)
	table.sort(extra)
	local lines = {}
	if #missing == 0 and #extra == 0 then
		lines[1] = "🔐 folders: in sync — config matches memory"
	else
		if #missing > 0 then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "missing from config (" .. #missing .. "): " .. table.concat(missing, ", ")
		end
		if #extra > 0 then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "in config, not in memory (" .. #extra .. ", manual ok): " .. table.concat(extra, ", ")
		end
	end
	for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
		vim.notify(l, vim.log.levels.INFO)
	end
	return { missing = missing, extra = extra }
end

--- Print the memory (stable verification command).
--- @return string[]
function M.summary()
	local rows = M.list()
	local cands = M.candidates()
	local lines = { string.format("folders: %d decided · %d candidate(s)", #rows, #cands) }
	for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"  #%s %-8s %-7s uses=%-3s %-40s %s",
			tostring(r.id),
			tostring(r.status),
			tostring(r.scope),
			tostring(r.uses or 0),
			tostring(r.path),
			tostring(r.note or "")
		)
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("  ?        %-7s uses=%-3s %s", "candidate", tostring(c.n), c.path)
	end
	for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
		print(l)
	end
	return lines
end

return M

-- /home/altjoe/.config/nvim/lua/opencode-manage/init.lua FINAL
-- opencode-manage — the review console for the opencode manage plugin.
-- Proposal review + change journal + registry review + verdict store/viewer
-- + metrics interface + references + skills lifecycle + permissions folders.
-- Completely separate from opencode-ext (the chat viewer) — no overlap.
--
-- VIEWERS: proposals (<leader>ap / <leader>ac), journal (<leader>aj),
-- registry (<leader>ar), verdicts (<leader>av), metrics (<leader>at),
-- references (<leader>af), skills (<leader>ak), folders (<leader>aa) —
-- all persistent two-pane viewers with live previews, no bland pickers.
-- COMMANDS: :ManageMetrics (summary), :ManagePrune [note] (shaped prune),
-- :ManageFolders (permissions memory + sync + verify),
-- :ManageIndex [root] / :ManageRef [path] / :ManageRefs /
-- :ManageRefPrune <id> <why> (references, doc 20).
-- Focus: BufEnter writes the active file so refs can route by what you work on.

local review = require("opencode-manage.review")
local reviewview = require("opencode-manage.reviewview")
local journalview = require("opencode-manage.journalview")
local registryview = require("opencode-manage.registryview")
local verdictview = require("opencode-manage.verdictview")
local metrics = require("opencode-manage.metrics")
local metricsview = require("opencode-manage.metricsview")
local refs = require("opencode-manage.refs")
local refsview = require("opencode-manage.refsview")
local skills = require("opencode-manage.skills")
local skillsview = require("opencode-manage.skillsview")
local folders = require("opencode-manage.folders")
local foldersview = require("opencode-manage.foldersview")

-- Keymaps
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>ap", reviewview.open, { desc = "Manage: review proposals" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>ac", reviewview.open, { desc = "Manage: review proposals (merged)" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>aj", journalview.open, { desc = "Manage: journal viewer" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>ar", registryview.open, { desc = "Manage: registry entries" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>av", verdictview.open, { desc = "Manage: verdict viewer" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>at", metricsview.open, { desc = "Manage: metrics viewer (turns + objects)" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>af", refsview.open, { desc = "Manage: references viewer" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>ak", skillsview.open, { desc = "Manage: skills lifecycle" })
vim.keymap.set("n", "<leader>aa", foldersview.open, { desc = "Manage: folder permissions" })

-- Stable commands (path resolution lives in code, not in pasted one-liners)
vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManageMetrics", function()
	metrics.summary()
end, { desc = "Manage: metrics store summary" })

vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManagePrune", function(opts)
	metrics.request_prune(opts.args ~= "" and opts.args or nil)
end, { nargs = "*", desc = "Manage: request a shaped context prune (next opencode message)" })

vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManageFolders", function()
	folders.summary()
end, { desc = "Manage: folder permissions memory (approve/avoid/sync/verify)" })

vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManageIndex", function(opts)
	refs.index(opts.args ~= "" and opts.args or vim.fn.getcwd())
end, { nargs = "?", complete = "dir", desc = "Manage: index references under a root" })

vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManageRef", function(opts)
	local path = opts.args ~= "" and opts.args or vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(0)
	if path == "" then
		vim.notify("❌ refs: no path given and the buffer has no file", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	refs.pin(path)
end, { nargs = "?", complete = "file", desc = "Manage: pin a reference" })

vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManageRefs", function()
	refs.summary()
end, { desc = "Manage: list references" })

vim.api.nvim_create_user_command("ManageRefPrune", function(opts)
	local id, reason = opts.args:match("^(%d+)%s+(.+)$")
	if not id then
		vim.notify("❌ usage: :ManageRefPrune <id> <reason>", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	refs.prune(tonumber(id), reason)
end, { nargs = "+", desc = "Manage: prune a reference, keeping the reason" })

-- R1: focus routing — write the active file so refs match what you work on.
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("BufEnter", {
	callback = function()
		local buf = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
		if vim.bo[buf].buftype ~= "" then
			return
		end
		local name = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_name(buf)
		if name ~= "" then
			refs.request_focus(name)
		end
	end,
})

-- API surface for scripting / later integration
return {
	review = review,
	reviewview = reviewview,
	journalview = journalview,
	registryview = registryview,
	verdictview = verdictview,
	metrics = metrics,
	metricsview = metricsview,
	refs = refs,
	refsview = refsview,
	skills = skills,
	skillsview = skillsview,
	folders = folders,
	foldersview = foldersview,
	proposals = require("opencode-manage.proposals"),
	journal = require("opencode-manage.journal"),
	registry = require("opencode-manage.registry"),
	verdicts = require("opencode-manage.verdicts"),
}

-- /home/altjoe/.config/nvim/lua/opencode-manage/json.lua FINAL
-- opencode-manage.json — the shared pretty JSON writer.
-- The registry consolidation's extraction target: pretty_json was duplicated
-- in registry.lua and skills.lua; folders.lua consumes this single helper,
-- and the other two migrate when that registry entry merges (their local
-- copies stay until then). Hand-reviewed artifacts are rewritten 2-space
-- with sorted keys; callers write with
--   vim.fn.writefile(vim.split(json.pretty(data), "\n", { plain = true }), file)

local M = {}

--- Pretty JSON, 2-space indent, sorted object keys.
--- @param val any
--- @param indent number|nil
--- @return string
function M.pretty(val, indent)
	indent = indent or 0
	local pad = string.rep("  ", indent)
	if type(val) == "table" then
		if vim.islist(val) then
			local parts = {}
			for _, v in ipairs(val) do
				parts[#parts + 1] = pad .. "  " .. M.pretty(v, indent + 1)
			end
			if #parts == 0 then
				return "[]"
			end
			return "[\n" .. table.concat(parts, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad .. "]"
		end
		local keys = {}
		for k in pairs(val) do
			keys[#keys + 1] = k
		end
		table.sort(keys)
		local parts = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
			parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s  %q: %s", pad, k, M.pretty(val[k], indent + 1))
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return "{}"
		end
		return "{\n" .. table.concat(parts, ",\n") .. "\n" .. pad .. "}"
	end
	if type(val) == "string" then
		return string.format("%q", val)
	end
	return tostring(val)
end

return M

# Permissions Manager — remember folders, verify they applied

Status: **active** — PM1 emitted (group `permissions-pm1`): folder memory +
`<leader>aa` viewer + journaled sync/drift-verify. PM2 (ignore files) and
PM3 (approval indexes refs) next.

Implements the intent-network folder-permissions design
(`../intent-network/02-permissions-tooling`) inside the manage console,
with one addition that matters: **verify** that remembered permissions are
actually in opencode's config, instead of assuming the write landed.

## The problem

- Every project re-asks for folders already trusted; opencode's
  `permission.external_directory` is hand-edited or forgotten.
- Approvals have no memory: what was approved lives in a config file
  nobody audits, and drift (hand-edit, typo, deleted entry) is invisible.
- The indexer and the capture offers walk into ignored trees
  (`node_modules`, build output), wasting attention.

## Contract

- **Memory vs enforcement.** state.db `folders` rows are the MEMORY;
  `opencode.json` `permission.external_directory` is the ENFORCEMENT
  surface. `s` sync writes the config (a console action, journaled,
  preserving every other key); `v` verify diffs memory against config and
  reports drift in both directions. No silent half-state.
- **Capture is free.** The plugin already tags every searched dir (O1 `dir`
  tags). The viewer offers those as candidates — approve once, never asked
  again.
- **Ignore files are respected, by git.** `git check-ignore --stdin` batch
  when the root is a repo (accurate, zero dependencies); `.ignore` +
  built-in patterns as the non-repo fallback. Ignored directories are never
  offered and never indexed.
- **Approval indexes.** Approving a folder runs the refs index over it and
  marks it `indexed`, so the folders you trust are also the folders the AI
  can cite your own code from (doc 20).

## Storage (state.db, additive)

| Table | Row | Columns |
|---|---|---|
| folders | one folder decision | id, ts, path, scope (project \| common), status (approved \| avoid), source (manual \| captured \| indexed), uses, last_seen, note |

`common` rows are the machine-wide trust set (the SCAN_ROOTS idea made
explicit: `~/projects`, `~/docs`, …); they apply in every project.

## Interface

- `<leader>aa` — the permissions viewer: approved / avoid / candidates
  (captured dirs not yet decided; PM1 filters hidden trees and paths
  covered by a decided ancestor — ignore-file filtering arrives with PM2).
  `a` approve (scope: common/project) · `x` avoid · `d` remove · `o` open
  folder · `s` sync to opencode.json · `v` verify (drift report) ·
  `r` refresh · `Q` close.
- Sync/verify target `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`
  `permission.external_directory` — an **object** of
  `"~/path/**": "allow"` entries (the design draft said "path array";
  corrected against the live config). Sync is **additive-only**: approved
  rows are merged in (pretty JSON, sorted keys — a one-time
  normalization); manual entries are never removed. Writes are journaled.

## As built (PM1)

- `lua/opencode-manage/folders.lua` — the memory + sync + verify layer:
  `folders` table (upsert on exact path; ancestors refuse duplicate
  approval), candidates from `event_tags` (kind `dir`, top 100, filtered:
  under `$HOME`, no hidden trees, not covered by a decided row), additive
  `sync()` with `journal.snapshot` + `record` (`op = "folders-sync"`), and
  `verify()` reporting `missing` (approved-not-in-config) and `extra`
  (config-not-in-memory, manual entries included — informational).
- `lua/opencode-manage/foldersview.lua` — `<leader>aa`; drift shows as a
  `!` marker + amber row; the verify report renders in the detail pane.
- `lua/opencode-manage/json.lua` — shared `pretty` (the registry
  consolidation's target); folders.lua consumes it, registry/skills keep
  their local copies until that entry merges.

## Restart semantics (verify live)

Whether a RUNNING opencode session picks up an `opencode.json` change is
unverified — until tested, sync reports: "written; restart opencode if the
running session still asks". `v` verify is the source of truth for the
FILE, not for process state. (First live test: approve `~/projects/shared`
— the component vault — sync, then check the running session.)

## Slices

| Slice | Content | State |
|---|---|---|
| **PM1** | folders table + viewer + sync/verify | emitted (group permissions-pm1) |
| **PM2** | gitignore/.ignore respect in the indexer + capture offers | next |
| **PM3** | approval → refs index + `indexed` marking | next |

## Honest limits

- nvim manages CONFIG and indexing — it cannot intercept opencode's read
  gate at runtime (that is opencode's own permission system).
- Captured candidates come from tool args (O1), so they show what the
  session touched, not everything under a root.
- `external_directory` is global config today; per-project scoping lives in
  our memory + generated globs (`~/projects/<x>/**`), not in opencode.

## Related

- `../intent-network/02-permissions-tooling` — the design this implements
- [20-references](20-references.md) — approval indexes refs; these ignore
  rules also govern the indexer
- [11-nvim-companion](11-nvim-companion.md) — the viewer family

-- /home/altjoe/.config/nvim/lua/opencode-manage/foldersview.lua FINAL
-- opencode-manage.foldersview — the permissions viewer (doc 23, PM1).
-- Persistent two-pane viewer over folder memory + captured candidates:
--   j/k move · a approve · x avoid · d remove · o open · b browse ·
--   s sync · v verify · r refresh · Q kill
-- Approve writes state.db memory; `s` merges approved rows into
-- opencode.json external_directory (journaled, additive-only); `v` reports
-- drift both ways. Candidates come from O1 dir tags (top 100, alphabetical),
-- filtered by hidden trees and decided ancestors — `b` browses the tree
-- oil-style instead (approve any folder, one key at every level).

local folders = require("opencode-manage.folders")

local M = {}

local state = {
	items = {},
	idx = 1,
	list_buf = nil,
	detail_buf = nil,
	list_win = nil,
	detail_win = nil,
	outer_win = nil,
	origin_win = nil,
	origin_buf = nil,
	autocmd = nil,
	report = nil, -- last verify report
}

local function define_hls()
	local hl = vim.api.nvim_set_hl
	hl(0, "ManageFolderOk", { fg = "#4ec9b0" }) -- approved
	hl(0, "ManageFolderAvoid", { fg = "#f44747" }) -- avoid
	hl(0, "ManageFolderCand", { fg = "#569cd6" }) -- candidate
	hl(0, "ManageFolderDrift", { fg = "#e5c07b" }) -- approved but not in config
	hl(0, "ManageFolderHeader", { link = "Comment" }) -- section headers
end

local function short(path)
	return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":~")
end

local function secs(v)
	local n = tonumber(v) or 0
	if n > 100000000000 then
		return n / 1000
	end
	return n
end

local function fmt_when(ts)
	local n = tonumber(ts)
	if not n or n == 0 then
		return "?"
	end
	return os.date("%m-%d %H:%M", math.floor(secs(n)))
end

local function load_items()
	local rows = folders.list()
	local cfg = folders.config_entries()
	local out = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
		out[#out + 1] = {
			kind = r.status == "avoid" and "avoid" or "approved",
			id = r.id,
			path = r.path,
			scope = r.scope,
			source = r.source,
			uses = r.uses or 0,
			last = r.last_seen,
			note = r.note,
			in_config = cfg[folders.entry_for(r.path)] ~= nil,
		}
	end
	local cands = folders.candidates()
	table.sort(cands, function(a, b)
		return a.path < b.path
	end)
	for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
		out[#out + 1] = {
			kind = "candidate",
			path = c.path,
			scope = "—",
			uses = c.n,
			last = c.last,
		}
	end
	state.items = out
	state.idx = math.max(1, math.min(state.idx, #out))
end

local function render_list()
	local lines = { "📁 FOLDERS" }
	local row_hl = {}
	local sel_line = 1
	local header_done = false
	for i, it in ipairs(state.items) do
		if it.kind == "candidate" and not header_done then
			header_done = true
			lines[#lines + 1] = "  — candidates (directories your sessions touched; `b` to browse) —"
			row_hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderHeader"
		end
		local marker = i == state.idx and ">" or " "
		local tag = it.kind == "approved" and "ok " or (it.kind == "avoid" and "x  " or "?  ")
		local drift = (it.kind == "approved" and not it.in_config) and " !" or ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"%s [%s] %-42s %-7s u=%-3s %s%s",
			marker,
			tag,
			short(it.path),
			tostring(it.scope or "—"),
			tostring(it.uses or 0),
			fmt_when(it.last),
			drift
		)
		row_hl[#lines] = (it.kind == "approved" and not it.in_config) and "ManageFolderDrift"
			or (it.kind == "approved" and "ManageFolderOk")
			or (it.kind == "avoid" and "ManageFolderAvoid")
			or "ManageFolderCand"
		if i == state.idx then
			sel_line = #lines
		end
	end
	if #state.items == 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  — none yet — `b` to browse for a folder, or approve from candidates as they appear —"
	end
	vim.bo[state.list_buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(state.list_buf, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[state.list_buf].modifiable = false
	local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("manage-folders")
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(state.list_buf, ns, 0, -1)
	for ln, hl in pairs(row_hl) do
		vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(state.list_buf, ns, hl, ln - 1, 0, -1)
	end
	pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor, state.list_win, { sel_line, 0 })
end

local function render_detail()
	local it = state.items[state.idx]
	local lines = {}
	if not it then
		lines = { "— nothing selected —" }
	else
		lines[#lines + 1] = "path:      " .. short(it.path)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "status:    " .. it.kind .. (it.id and ("  (id " .. tostring(it.id) .. ")") or "")
		lines[#lines + 1] = "scope:     " .. tostring(it.scope or "—")
		if it.kind ~= "candidate" then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "source:    " .. tostring(it.source or "manual")
			lines[#lines + 1] = "in config: " .. (it.in_config and "yes" or "NO — press s to sync")
		end
		lines[#lines + 1] = "uses:      " .. tostring(it.uses or 0) .. "  ·  last: " .. fmt_when(it.last)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "note:      " .. tostring(it.note or "—")
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.rep("─", 44)
		lines[#lines + 1] = "a approve · x avoid · d remove · o open · b browse · s sync · v verify"
		if state.report then
			lines[#lines + 1] = string.rep("─", 44)
			lines[#lines + 1] = "verify:"
			if #state.report.missing == 0 and #state.report.extra == 0 then
				lines[#lines + 1] = "  in sync"
			else
				for _, m in ipairs(state.report.missing) do
					lines[#lines + 1] = "  missing from config: " .. m
				end
				for _, e in ipairs(state.report.extra) do
					lines[#lines + 1] = "  in config, not in memory: " .. e
				end
			end
		end
	end
	vim.bo[state.detail_buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(state.detail_buf, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[state.detail_buf].modifiable = false
end

local function set_legend()
	if not state.list_win or not vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.list_win) then
		return
	end
	-- Plain concatenation: winbar markers (%#…#%*) are NOT format strings
	-- (string.format rejected "%#M" and broke refresh).
	vim.wo[state.list_win].winbar = "FOLDERS · "
		.. #state.items
		.. " · %#ManageFolderOk#[ok]%* approved  %#ManageFolderCand#[?]%* candidate"
		.. "  %#ManageFolderAvoid#[x]%* avoid  %#ManageFolderDrift#!%* drift"
		.. " · b browse · a x d o s v r Q"
end

local function refresh()
	load_items()
	render_list()
	render_detail()
	set_legend()
end

local function current()
	return state.items[state.idx]
end

local function do_approve()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if it.kind == "approved" then
		vim.notify("folders: already approved", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return
	end
	vim.ui.select({ "common", "project" }, { prompt = "scope for " .. short(it.path) }, function(scope)
		if not scope then
			return
		end
		if folders.approve(it.path, scope, nil, it.uses, it.last) then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
end

local function do_avoid()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if folders.avoid(it.path) then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function do_remove()
	local it = current()
	if not it or not it.id then
		vim.notify("folders: no row to remove (candidate — x to avoid, a to approve)", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return
	end
	local choice = vim.fn.confirm(
		"Remove the memory row for " .. short(it.path) .. "?\n(config entries stay; sync never deletes)",
		"&Remove\n&Cancel",
		2
	)
	if choice ~= 1 then
		return
	end
	if folders.remove(it.id) then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function do_open()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(it.path) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("folders: not a directory: " .. it.path, vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf, state.origin_win, state.origin_buf)
	pcall(vim.cmd, "edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(it.path))
end

--- Oil-flavored folder picker: walk the filesystem with ui.select; every
--- level offers "approve this folder (save)". Starts at the selected path
--- when it is a directory, else cwd. Approving uses the same scope select.
local function browse(dir)
	dir = dir or vim.fn.getcwd()
	local entries = vim.fn.glob(dir .. "/*", false, true)
	local dirs = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
		if vim.fn.isdirectory(e) == 1 and not e:find("/%.") then
			dirs[#dirs + 1] = e
		end
	end
	table.sort(dirs)
	local choices = { "✅ approve " .. short(dir) .. " (save)" }
	if dir ~= "/" then
		choices[#choices + 1] = "⬆ .. " .. short(vim.fn.fnamemodify(dir, ":h"))
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
		choices[#choices + 1] = "📁 " .. vim.fn.fnamemodify(d, ":t") .. "/"
	end
	vim.ui.select(choices, { prompt = "browse: " .. short(dir) }, function(choice)
		if not choice then
			return
		end
		local name = choice:match("^📁 (.+)/$")
		if choice:match("^✅") then
			vim.ui.select({ "common", "project" }, { prompt = "scope for " .. short(dir) }, function(scope)
				if scope and folders.approve(dir, scope) then
					refresh()
				end
			end)
		elseif choice:match("^⬆") then
			browse(vim.fn.fnamemodify(dir, ":h"))
		elseif name then
			browse(dir .. "/" .. name)
		end
	end)
end

local function do_browse()
	local it = current()
	local start
	if it and vim.fn.isdirectory(it.path) == 1 then
		start = it.path
	else
		start = vim.fn.getcwd()
	end
	browse(start)
end

local function do_sync()
	folders.sync()
	refresh()
end

local function do_verify()
	state.report = folders.verify()
	render_detail()
end

local function kill()
	if state.autocmd then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_del_autocmd, state.autocmd)
		state.autocmd = nil
	end
	for _, w in ipairs({ state.list_win, state.detail_win, state.outer_win }) do
		if w and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(w) then
			pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_close, w, true)
		end
	end
	if state.origin_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.origin_win) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_set_current_win, state.origin_win)
	end
end

local function map_keys()
	local function nmap(lhs, fn, desc)
		vim.keymap.set("n", lhs, fn, { buffer = state.list_buf, nowait = true, desc = desc })
	end
	nmap("j", function()
		state.idx = math.min(state.idx + 1, #state.items)
		refresh()
	end, "folders: next")
	nmap("k", function()
		state.idx = math.max(state.idx - 1, 1)
		refresh()
	end, "folders: prev")
	nmap("a", do_approve, "folders: approve")
	nmap("x", do_avoid, "folders: avoid")
	nmap("d", do_remove, "folders: remove row")
	nmap("o", do_open, "folders: open")
	nmap("b", do_browse, "folders: browse & approve")
	nmap("s", do_sync, "folders: sync config")
	nmap("v", do_verify, "folders: verify drift")
	nmap("r", refresh, "folders: refresh")
	nmap("Q", kill, "folders: close")
	nmap("<CR>", do_open, "folders: open")
end

function M.open()
	define_hls()
	state.origin_win = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
	state.origin_buf = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
	state.list_buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	state.detail_buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	for _, b in ipairs({ state.list_buf, state.detail_buf }) do
		vim.bo[b].buftype = "nofile"
		vim.bo[b].bufhidden = "wipe"
		vim.bo[b].swapfile = false
	end
	local total_w = vim.o.columns
	local total_h = vim.o.lines - vim.o.cmdheight - 1
	local list_w = math.max(30, math.floor(total_w * 0.45))
	local detail_w = total_w - list_w - 1
	state.outer_win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.list_buf, true, {
		relative = "editor",
		row = 0,
		col = 0,
		width = total_w,
		height = total_h,
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	vim.wo[state.outer_win].winbar = "FOLDERS"
	state.list_win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.list_buf, true, {
		relative = "win",
		win = state.outer_win,
		row = 0,
		col = 0,
		width = list_w,
		height = total_h,
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	state.detail_win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.detail_buf, false, {
		relative = "win",
		win = state.outer_win,
		row = 0,
		col = list_w + 1,
		width = detail_w,
		height = total_h,
		border = "none",
		style = "minimal",
	})
	vim.wo[state.detail_win].winbar = "DETAIL"
	state.autocmd = vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("WinEnter", {
		callback = function()
			if vim.api.nvim_get_current_win() ~= state.list_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.list_win) then
				vim.schedule(function()
					if vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.list_win) then
						pcall(vim.api.nvim_set_current_win, state.list_win)
					end
				end)
			end
		end,
	})
	map_keys()
	refresh()
	vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(state.list_win)
end

return M

-- /home/altjoe/.config/nvim/lua/opencode-manage/foldersview.lua FINAL
-- opencode-manage.foldersview — permissions viewer (doc 23, PM1, simplified).
-- ONE panel: the saved list. `a` opens an oil float at the tmux pane cwd
-- (fallback: nvim cwd) — navigate exactly like oil, then `A` (or `o`) saves
-- the directory you are viewing (scope prompt). No second pane: verify output
-- lands as footer lines.
--   j/k move · a browse+save (oil) · x avoid · d remove · o open ·
--   s sync · v verify · Q close
-- Approve writes state.db memory; `s` merges approved rows into
-- opencode.json external_directory (journaled, additive-only); `v` reports
-- drift both ways.

local folders = require("opencode-manage.folders")

local M = {}

local state = {
	rows = {},
	idx = 1,
	buf = nil,
	win = nil,
	origin_win = nil,
	origin_buf = nil,
	report = nil, -- last verify report
}

local function define_hls()
	local hl = vim.api.nvim_set_hl
	hl(0, "ManageFolderOk", { fg = "#4ec9b0" }) -- approved + in config
	hl(0, "ManageFolderAvoid", { fg = "#f44747" }) -- avoid
	hl(0, "ManageFolderDrift", { fg = "#e5c07b" }) -- approved but not in config
	hl(0, "ManageFolderHint", { link = "Comment" }) -- footer lines
end

local function short(path)
	return vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":~")
end

local function secs(v)
	local n = tonumber(v) or 0
	if n > 100000000000 then
		return n / 1000
	end
	return n
end

local function fmt_when(ts)
	local n = tonumber(ts)
	if not n or n == 0 then
		return "?"
	end
	return os.date("%m-%d %H:%M", math.floor(secs(n)))
end

--- The tmux pane cwd (where you actually are), fallback nvim cwd.
--- @return string
local function browse_root()
	local out = vim.fn.system({ "tmux", "display-message", "-p", "#{pane_current_path}" })
	if vim.v.shell_error == 0 and type(out) == "string" then
		local dir = vim.trim(out)
		if dir ~= "" and vim.fn.isdirectory(dir) == 1 then
			return dir
		end
	end
	return vim.fn.getcwd()
end

local function load_rows()
	local cfg = folders.config_entries()
	local rows = folders.list()
	for _, r in ipairs(rows) do
		r.in_config = cfg[folders.entry_for(r.path)] ~= nil
	end
	state.rows = rows
	state.idx = math.max(1, math.min(state.idx, #rows))
end

local function render()
	local lines = { "📁 FOLDERS — " .. #state.rows .. " saved" }
	local hl = {}
	local sel = 1
	for i, r in ipairs(state.rows) do
		local marker = i == state.idx and ">" or " "
		local tag = r.status == "avoid" and "x " or "ok"
		local drift = (r.status ~= "avoid" and not r.in_config) and " !" or ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"%s [%s] %-44s %-7s u=%-3s %s%s",
			marker,
			tag,
			short(r.path),
			tostring(r.scope),
			tostring(r.uses or 0),
			fmt_when(r.last_seen),
			drift
		)
		hl[#lines] = (r.status == "avoid" and "ManageFolderAvoid")
			or (not r.in_config and "ManageFolderDrift")
			or "ManageFolderOk"
		if i == state.idx then
			sel = #lines
		end
	end
	if #state.rows == 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  — none saved — press a to browse (oil) and save a folder —"
		hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderHint"
	end
	if state.report then
		lines[#lines + 1] = "  ── verify ──"
		hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderHint"
		if #state.report.missing == 0 and #state.report.extra == 0 then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "  in sync"
			hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderOk"
		else
			for _, m in ipairs(state.report.missing) do
				lines[#lines + 1] = "  missing from config: " .. m
				hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderDrift"
			end
			for _, e in ipairs(state.report.extra) do
				lines[#lines + 1] = "  in config, not in memory: " .. e
				hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderHint"
			end
		end
	end
	lines[#lines + 1] = "  a browse+save (oil) · x avoid · d remove · o open · s sync · v verify · Q close"
	hl[#lines] = "ManageFolderHint"
	vim.bo[state.buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(state.buf, 0, -1, false, lines)
	vim.bo[state.buf].modifiable = false
	local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("manage-folders")
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(state.buf, ns, 0, -1)
	for ln, h in pairs(hl) do
		vim.api.nvim_buf_add_highlight(state.buf, ns, h, ln - 1, 0, -1)
	end
	pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor, state.win, { sel, 0 })
end

local function refresh()
	load_rows()
	render()
end

local function current()
	return state.rows[state.idx]
end

--- Approve a directory (scope prompt) — shared by the list and the oil float.
local function approve_dir(dir)
	if type(dir) ~= "string" or dir == "" or vim.fn.isdirectory(dir) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("folders: not a directory: " .. tostring(dir), vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	vim.ui.select({ "common", "project" }, { prompt = "scope for " .. short(dir) }, function(scope)
		if not scope then
			return
		end
		if folders.approve(dir, scope) then
			refresh()
		end
	end)
end

--- `a`: open oil at the tmux pane cwd; `A`/`o` inside saves the dir you are
--- viewing. oil is your explorer — its `-`, `<CR>`, filters all work as usual.
local function browse()
	local dir = browse_root()
	pcall(vim.cmd, "Oil --float " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(dir))
	local oil_buf = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
	local function save_current()
		local ok, oil = pcall(require, "oil")
		local current_dir = dir
		if ok and type(oil.get_current_dir) == "function" then
			current_dir = oil.get_current_dir(oil_buf) or dir
		end
		approve_dir(current_dir)
	end
	for _, lhs in ipairs({ "A", "o" }) do
		vim.keymap.set("n", lhs, save_current, {
			buffer = oil_buf,
			nowait = true,
			desc = "folders: save this directory",
		})
	end
	vim.notify("folders: navigate, then A (or o) to save this directory", vim.log.levels.INFO)
end

local function do_avoid()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if folders.avoid(it.path) then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function do_remove()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	local choice = vim.fn.confirm(
		"Remove the memory row for " .. short(it.path) .. "?\n(config entries stay; sync never deletes)",
		"&Remove\n&Cancel",
		2
	)
	if choice ~= 1 then
		return
	end
	if folders.remove(it.id) then
		refresh()
	end
end

local function do_open()
	local it = current()
	if not it then
		return
	end
	if vim.fn.isdirectory(it.path) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("folders: not a directory: " .. it.path, vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	if state.origin_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.origin_win) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_set_current_win, state.origin_win)
	end
	pcall(vim.cmd, "edit " .. vim.fn.fnameescape(it.path))
end

local function do_sync()
	folders.sync()
	refresh()
end

local function do_verify()
	state.report = folders.verify()
	render()
end

local function kill()
	for _, w in ipairs({ state.win }) do
		if w and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(w) then
			pcall(vim.api.nvim_win_close, w, true)
		end
	end
	if state.origin_win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.origin_win) then
		pcall(vim.api.nvim_set_current_win, state.origin_win)
	end
end

local function map_keys()
	local function nmap(lhs, fn, desc)
		vim.keymap.set("n", lhs, fn, { buffer = state.buf, nowait = true, desc = desc })
	end
	nmap("j", function()
		state.idx = math.min(state.idx + 1, #state.rows)
		render()
	end, "folders: next")
	nmap("k", function()
		state.idx = math.max(state.idx - 1, 1)
		render()
	end, "folders: prev")
	nmap("a", browse, "folders: browse (oil) + save")
	nmap("x", do_avoid, "folders: avoid")
	nmap("d", do_remove, "folders: remove row")
	nmap("o", do_open, "folders: open folder")
	nmap("s", do_sync, "folders: sync config")
	nmap("v", do_verify, "folders: verify drift")
	nmap("r", refresh, "folders: refresh")
	nmap("Q", kill, "folders: close")
	nmap("q", kill, "folders: close")
	nmap("<Esc>", kill, "folders: close")
end

function M.open()
	define_hls()
	if state.win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.win) then
		refresh()
		vim.api.nvim_set_current_win(state.win)
		return
	end
	state.origin_win = vim.api.nvim_get_current_win()
	state.origin_buf = vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()
	state.buf = vim.api.nvim_create_buf(false, true)
	vim.bo[state.buf].buftype = "nofile"
	vim.bo[state.buf].bufhidden = "wipe"
	vim.bo[state.buf].swapfile = false
	state.win = vim.api.nvim_open_win(state.buf, true, {
		relative = "editor",
		width = math.max(60, math.floor(vim.o.columns * 0.5)),
		height = math.max(10, math.min(#state.rows + 4, math.floor(vim.o.lines * 0.6))),
		row = math.floor(vim.o.lines * 0.15),
		col = math.floor(vim.o.columns * 0.25),
		style = "minimal",
		border = "rounded",
		title = " FOLDERS ",
		title_pos = "center",
	})
	vim.wo[state.win].cursorline = true
	vim.wo[state.win].winhighlight = "CursorLine:Visual"
	map_keys()
	refresh()
end

return M

--- Drift report per scope: approved-without-config (missing) and
--- config-without-row (extra — manual entries included, informational).
--- Labels are "<scope>:<entry>".
--- @return table  { missing = string[], extra = string[] }
function M.verify()
	local missing, extra = {}, {}
	for _, scope in ipairs({ "common", "project" }) do
		local ext = M.config_entries(scope)
		local approved = {}
		for _, r in ipairs(M.list()) do
			if r.status == "approved" and r.scope == scope then
				approved[M.entry_for(r.path)] = true
			end
		end
		for k in pairs(approved) do
			if ext[k] == nil then
				missing[#missing + 1] = scope .. ":" .. k
			end
		end
		for k in pairs(ext) do
			if not approved[k] then
				extra[#extra + 1] = scope .. ":" .. k
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(missing)
	table.sort(extra)
	local lines = {}
	if #missing == 0 and #extra == 0 then
		lines[1] = "🔐 folders: in sync — both configs match memory"
	else
		if #missing > 0 then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "missing from config (" .. #missing .. "): " .. table.concat(missing, ", ")
		end
		if #extra > 0 then
			lines[#lines + 1] = "in config, not in memory (" .. #extra .. ", manual ok): " .. table.concat(extra, ", ")
		end
	end
	for _, l in ipairs(lines) do
		vim.notify(l, vim.log.levels.INFO)
	end
	return { missing = missing, extra = extra }
end
reason: verify() per scope: each of common/project is diffed against its own config file; labels carry the scope. Applied LAST (bottom-up emission keeps coordinates valid).

--- Merge the approved rows of one scope into its config (journaled,
--- additive-only, pretty/sorted; a missing project config is created with
--- the $schema line). Returns added entries, {} when nothing to add, or nil
--- on failure (already notified).
--- @param scope string  "common" (global file) | "project"
--- @param file string|nil
--- @return string[]|nil
local function sync_scope(scope, file)
	if not file then
		return {}
	end
	local existed = vim.fn.filereadable(file) == 1
	local data = {}
	if existed then
		local f = io.open(file, "r")
		if not f then
			vim.notify("❌ folders: cannot open " .. file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return nil
		end
		local raw = f:read("*a")
		f:close()
		local ok, decoded = pcall(vim.json.decode, raw)
		if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
			vim.notify("❌ folders: config does not parse: " .. file, vim.log.levels.ERROR)
			return nil
		end
		data = decoded
	else
		data["$schema"] = "https://opencode.ai/config.json"
	end
	local perm = data.permission
	if type(perm) ~= "table" then
		perm = {}
		data.permission = perm
	end
	local ext = perm.external_directory
	if type(ext) ~= "table" then
		ext = {}
		perm.external_directory = ext
	end
	local added = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(M.list()) do
		if r.status == "approved" and r.scope == scope then
			local key = M.entry_for(r.path)
			if ext[key] == nil then
				ext[key] = "allow"
				added[#added + 1] = key
			end
		end
	end
	if #added == 0 then
		return {}
	end
	local snap = journal.snapshot(file)
	vim.fn.writefile(vim.split(json.pretty(data), "\n", { plain = true }), file)
	journal.record({
		ts = os.time() * 1000,
		path = file,
		group = "folders",
		op = "folders-sync",
		snapshot = snap,
		existed = snap ~= nil,
		reason = scope .. ": external_directory += " .. table.concat(added, ", "),
		sessionID = nil,
	})
	return added
end

--- Sync both scopes: common -> global config; project -> the project's own
--- config (deep-merged over global by opencode — global denies survive).
--- Additive-only; manual entries are never removed.
--- @return table|nil  { added = entry[] } or nil on failure
function M.sync()
	local total = {}
	for _, job in ipairs({
		{ scope = "common", file = config_path() },
		{ scope = "project", file = project_config_path() },
	}) do
		local added = sync_scope(job.scope, job.file)
		if added == nil then
			return nil
		end
		for _, a in ipairs(added) do
			total[#total + 1] = a
		end
	end
	if #total == 0 then
		vim.notify("🔐 folders: both configs already cover every approved folder", vim.log.levels.INFO)
		return { added = {} }
	end
	vim.notify("🔐 folders: synced " .. #total .. " entr(y/ies) into external_directory", vim.log.levels.INFO)
	return { added = total }
end

local function save_current()
	local d = nil
	local ok, oil = pcall(require, "oil")
	if ok and type(oil.get_current_dir) == "function" then
		d = oil.get_current_dir(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf())
	end
	d = d or state.browse_dir
	vim.notify("folders: saving " .. short(d) .. " …", vim.log.levels.INFO)

end

local function bind_oil(buf)
	vim.keymap.set("n", "A", save_current, {
		buffer = buf,
		nowait = true,
		silent = true,
		desc = "folders: save this directory",
	})
	vim.keymap.set("n", "o", save_current, {
		buffer = buf,
		nowait = true,
		silent = true,
		desc = "folders: save this directory",

	vim.keymap.set("n", "Q", kill, {

		nowait = true,
		silent = true,

	})

			buffer = buf,
			nowait = true,
			silent = true,

end

local function browse()

		vim.notify("folders: oil could not open " .. short(dir), vim.log.levels.WARN)

	-- Late bind: map on whatever oil buffer lands in OUR float — now, and on

	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ "FileType", "BufEnter" }, {
		group = group,
		pattern = "oil",
		callback = function(ev)
			if not (state.win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.win)) then

			if vim.api.nvim_win_get_buf(state.win) ~= ev.buf then

--- Scope is automatic (no prompt): a folder inside the current project is
--- "project" (this repo's config); anywhere else is "common" (global).
local function auto_scope(dir)
	local root = folders.project_root()
	if root and (dir == root or dir:sub(1, #root + 1) == root .. "/") then
		return "project"
	end
	return "common"
end

--- Save a directory with the automatic scope; the row shows it afterwards.
local function save_dir(dir)
	if type(dir) ~= "string" or dir == "" or vim.fn.isdirectory(dir) ~= 1 then
		vim.notify("folders: not a directory: " .. tostring(dir), vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	local scope = auto_scope(dir)
	if folders.approve(dir, scope) then
		vim.notify(("folders: saved %s (%s)"):format(short(dir), scope), vim.log.levels.INFO)
		refresh()
	end
end

--- Back from oil to the saved list, same window.
local function return_to_list()
	if state.win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.win) then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_buf(state.win, state.buf)
		set_title(" FOLDERS ")
		refresh()
	end
end

--- `a` (in oil): save the HIGHLIGHTED row when it is a directory.
local function save_row()
	local ok, oil = pcall(require, "oil")
	if not ok or type(oil.get_cursor_entry) ~= "function" then
		vim.notify("folders: oil API unavailable — A saves the containing folder", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	local entry = oil.get_cursor_entry()
	if type(entry) ~= "table" or type(entry.name) ~= "string" then
		vim.notify("folders: nothing under the cursor", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	local dir = nil
	if type(oil.get_current_dir) == "function" then
		dir = oil.get_current_dir(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf())
	end
	dir = dir or state.browse_dir
	local target = dir .. "/" .. entry.name
	if entry.type ~= "directory" then
		vim.notify("folders: " .. short(target) .. " is not a folder (a = highlighted row, A = containing folder)", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	vim.notify("folders: saving " .. short(target) .. " …", vim.log.levels.INFO)
	save_dir(target)
end

--- `A` (in oil): save the CONTAINING folder (the one you are inside).
local function save_here()
	local d = nil
	local ok, oil = pcall(require, "oil")
	if ok and type(oil.get_current_dir) == "function" then
		d = oil.get_current_dir(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf())
	end
	d = d or state.browse_dir
	vim.notify("folders: saving containing folder " .. short(d) .. " …", vim.log.levels.INFO)
	save_dir(d)
end

--- Bind our keys on the oil buffer actually shown in OUR float. Called on
--- FileType/BufEnter/OilEnter — late enough that oil's own setup cannot win.
local function bind_oil(buf)
	local function map(lhs, fn, desc)
		vim.keymap.set("n", lhs, fn, {
			buffer = buf,
			nowait = true,
			silent = true,
			desc = desc,
		})
	end
	map("a", save_row, "folders: save highlighted row")
	map("A", save_here, "folders: save containing folder")
	map("q", return_to_list, "folders: back to list")
	map("<Esc>", return_to_list, "folders: back to list")
	map("Q", kill, "folders: close")
end

local function browse()
	local dir = browse_root()
	state.browse_dir = dir
	local ok, oil = pcall(require, "oil")
	if not ok or type(oil.open) ~= "function" then
		vim.notify("folders: oil not available for browsing", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	local opened = pcall(oil.open, dir)
	if not opened then
		vim.notify("folders: oil could not open " .. short(dir), vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	set_title(" FOLDERS · browse — a row · A folder · q back · Q close ")
	local group = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup("manage_folders_oil", { clear = true })
	local function maybe_bind(ev)
		if not (state.win and vim.api.nvim_win_is_valid(state.win)) then
			return
		end
		local shown = vim.api.nvim_win_get_buf(state.win)
		if shown ~= ev.buf and shown ~= vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf() then
			return
		end
		bind_oil(shown)
	end
	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ "FileType", "BufEnter" }, {
		group = group,
		pattern = "oil",
		callback = maybe_bind,
	})
	-- Oil's own "entered" event: the most reliable late point.
	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("User", {
		group = group,
		pattern = "OilEnter",
		callback = maybe_bind,
	})
	if vim.bo[vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf()].filetype == "oil" then
		bind_oil(vim.api.nvim_get_current_buf())
	end
	vim.notify("folders: a saves the highlighted row · A saves the containing folder · q back", vim.log.levels.INFO)
end

# Bootstrap — the first-time setup a project needs

Status: active. This doc is the **canonical, updatable home** of the
procedure; the `manage-bootstrap` skill is a thin pointer here (so the
skill cannot drift — update this doc and every session picks the change
up).

## When to run

Starting manage-plugin work in a project that is missing any of:

- `.opencode/manage.ui.json` — the UI layout contract (UI projects only;
  doc 25)
- `.opencode/manage.registry.json` — the shared-logic registry (doc 17)
- a refs index (`:ManageIndex`) and/or approved folders (`<leader>aa`)
- (later) the env-redaction registry (doc 24, RX1 pending)

## Generate: the UI contract (UI projects)

1. Read the project's own UI first — the templ pages, panel ids,
   `hx-target`/`hx-swap` usage, OOB fragments, view-conditional
   components. The contract must describe what is there, not what we wish
   were there.
2. Draft `.opencode/manage.ui.json` per the doc 25 schema (pages → views →
   panels, targets, actions, view_conditional, components, shell).
3. Propose it as a full-file create (the reviewed channel; LC1 shape-gates
   the draft before it queues).
4. Expect iteration: LC3 blocks emissions that contradict the contract
   until both agree — that disagreement is the feature; resolve it in the
   contract or in the code, deliberately.

## Generate: the registry (doc 17)

- Inventory the project for genuinely shared modules and canonical
  implementations (things multiple call sites depend on).
- Propose entries with `registry_propose` (reviewed in `<leader>ar`, which
  merges the summary).
- Do not register one-off helpers; the registry is for sharing, not
  cataloguing.

## User-side requirements (name them; the AI cannot run them)

- `:ManageIndex <root>` — index refs for the project.
- `<leader>aa` — approve folders (PM1; approval indexes refs by default,
  PM3).
- Env-redaction registry — when RX1 lands (doc 24).
- Nothing is written until reviewed: every generated artifact above rides
  the normal proposal/registry queues.

## Verification

- Contract: LC1 accepted it; LC3 stops queueing contradicting emissions.
- Registry: `<leader>ar` shows the summary; `impact` is required when
  touching registered modules.
- Folders/refs: `<leader>aa` shows the rows; `v` verifies drift.

## Updating

This doc is the procedure. When the steps change (new requirement, new
gate, new artifact), edit THIS document — the skill picks the change up
immediately, with no skill edits.

--- Subject from a path: parent dir + extension (same rule as the plugin).
--- @param path string

function M.subject(path)
	local dir = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":h:t")
	local ext = vim.fn.fnamemodify(path, ":e"):lower()
	return table.concat(vim.tbl_filter(function(s)
		return s ~= ""
	end, { dir, ext }), " ")

--- Index files under a root. Live pointers only; pruned entries are not
--- resurrected and existing entries are skipped. Creates the store.
--- opts.global = true writes the GLOBAL store with scope 'global' (the
--- vault); default stays the project store.
--- @param root string
--- @param opts table|nil  { global = boolean }
--- @return number  inserted count
function M.index(root, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local db = opts.global and open_global_writable() or open_writable()
	if not db then
		return 0
	end
	local scope = opts.global and "global" or "project"

	local files = {}
	for _, ext in ipairs(INDEX_EXTS) do
		for _, f in ipairs(vim.fn.globpath(root, "**/*." .. ext, false, true)) do
			local skip = false
			for _, pat in ipairs(SKIP_PATTERNS) do
				if f:find(pat, 1, true) then
					skip = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not skip then
				files[#files + 1] = f
			end
			if #files >= 800 then
				break
			end
		end
		if #files >= 800 then
			break
		end
	end

	local inserted = 0
	local now = os.time() * 1000
	pcall(function()
		db:execute("BEGIN")
		for _, f in ipairs(files) do
			local exists = false
			local rows = db:eval("SELECT id FROM refs WHERE path = :path LIMIT 1", { path = f })
			if type(rows) == "table" and rows[1] then
				exists = true
			end
			if not exists then
				local res = db:eval(
					"INSERT INTO refs (ts, source, kind, path, subject, scope) "
						.. "VALUES (?, 'index', 'file', ?, ?, ?)",
					{ now, f, M.subject(f), scope }
				)
				if res ~= false then
					inserted = inserted + 1
				end
			end
		end
		db:execute("COMMIT")
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	vim.notify(
		string.format("📚 refs: indexed %d new file(s) under %s (%s)", inserted, root, scope),
		vim.log.levels.INFO
	)
	return inserted
end

local function save_dir(dir)

		vim.notify("folders: not a directory: " .. tostring(dir), vim.log.levels.WARN)

	local scope = auto_scope(dir)
	if folders.approve(dir, scope) then

		if ok then

		end
		refresh()

end

--- Read-only open of the global vault store (nil when absent/unusable).
--- @return table|nil
local function open_global()
	local path = (vim.env.HOME or "") .. "/.config/opencode/state.db"
	if vim.fn.filereadable(path) ~= 1 then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, db = pcall(function()
		if not sqlite then
			sqlite = require("sqlite")
		end
		return sqlite:open(path)
	end)
	if not ok or type(db) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	pcall(function()
		db:execute(REFS_SCHEMA)
	end)
	return db
end

--- Global vault list (unpruned first, most used first).
--- @return table[]
function M.list_global()
	local db = open_global()
	if not db then
		return {}
	end
	local rows = {}
	pcall(function()
		local res = db:eval(
			"SELECT id, source, kind, subject, path, symbol, uses, last_used, pruned_ts, prune_reason "
				.. "FROM refs ORDER BY (pruned_ts IS NOT NULL), uses DESC, ts DESC LIMIT 300"
		)
		if type(res) == "table" then
			rows = res
		end
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	return rows
end

--- Prune a GLOBAL vault ref (reason kept; the vault viewer's `d`).
--- @param id number
--- @param reason string
--- @return boolean
function M.prune_global(id, reason)
	local db = open_global_writable()
	if not db then
		return false
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		db:eval("UPDATE refs SET pruned_ts = ?, prune_reason = ? WHERE id = ?", {
			os.time() * 1000,
			reason,
			tonumber(id),
		})
	end)
	pcall(function()
		db:close()
	end)
	if ok then
		vim.notify("🗑 vault ref pruned: #" .. tostring(id), vim.log.levels.INFO)
	end
	return ok
end
